source.title: City of Bastrop FY2025-26 Annual Operating & Capital Budget

meta.note: The City of Bastrop (the county seat) — a separate government from Bastrop County. The bars are the city’s General Fund ($18.6M); Police and Fire are about two-thirds of it. Bastrop also runs its own electric utility (Bastrop Power & Light, $9.5M) and a Water & Wastewater fund ($10.0M) as self-supporting enterprises. The city budgets fund by fund and publishes no single all-funds total. Police, Fire, Parks, HR, and the City Secretary are the confirmed department totals; the rest are grouped.
facts: Police and Fire together are ~67% of the city’s General Fund.
Bastrop owns its electric utility — Bastrop Power & Light — a $9.5M enterprise fund.
This is the CITY of Bastrop, distinct from Bastrop County ($93.7M).
